category_title: Low-achieving male vocational students with a preference for digital tasks over traditional writing
minimal_context: The student is asked to post questions 1 and 2 from their recent exam about drawing circuits to their blog.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that the exam is over, please post questions 1 and 2 from the exam, which involve drawing circuits, to your blog.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: We just had an exam for the first two sessions. I'm exhausted and I really don't want to do another assignment right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You still need to complete the work for today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is annoying. I don't like working under pressure like this right after a test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you don't finish the assignment, you will risk not playing Counterstrike later.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks over at another student's screen) Fine. I'm just going to copy his circuit drawing so I don't fail the class.
